observations: Large solar panel with half-cut cell design.
Back side shows three junction boxes and cables with MC4 connectors.
A specification label is visible on the back but the text is unreadable.
Watermark 'NETWORK SOLAR VENTURES' appears on all photos.
Date stamp '2025/08/07' is in the future.
Location tag 'Lagos, Nigeria' is on the photos.

claims.evidence: The text is a general business introduction with no specific product claims.

risks.risk: The rated wattage and electrical specifications are unknown.
risks.proof: A clear, legible close-up photo of the specification label on the back of the panel.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic 300W panel (conservative for this physical size)

risks.risk: The panel may be non-functional or have significantly degraded output.
risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter reading of the open-circuit voltage (Voc) and short-circuit current (Isc) in direct sunlight.

risks.risk: Internal damage such as micro-cracks or snail trails not visible in low-res photos.
risks.proof: High-resolution close-up photos of the cells under bright light.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used with heavy wear

proof_requests: Clear photo of the specification label on the back of the panel.
Video of a multimeter test showing voltage and current output in sunlight.
Confirmation of the actual current date, as the photo timestamp is in the future.
response.reason: The specification label that defines the wattage and model is unreadable, making it impossible to determine a base price even for a worst-case scenario.
